content.html:
• This week brought motivational speeches and wine. Luckily: at no point did the two intersect.
  • What do I know about wine? Not much other than the expression “In vino veritas” (and the rare follow-up, “et veritas est periculosa”). Asking for “fully bodied” seems to do the trick.
  • The temperature has dropped and it’s now bitterly cold: So as my old one is out of commission, I went on a mission with my stylist to secure a new winter coat (and some other things) and I could not be happier with the result.
  • My security audit tool works, relatively well? I’m happy with its direction at least.
  • Looking back at photos of food this week, this wasn’t a healthy week: But my latest panel says that my cholesterol is still a bit lower than it should be.
  • I was tricked into watching JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure and I love it. It’s perfect immersion content, and strange/cheesy enough that I don’t mind the anime cliches!
  • Whose idea was it to put a kilotonne of sausages on a charcuterie board anyway?
  • I have completed the N3 grammar textbook but I have not internalised it all yet. Every new thing I learn reminds me how hard it is to learn a language: But as a wise colleague said, it took them years to get to their current level so I shouldn’t fret.
  • Also updated /now with some notes about side projects!
  • How do you celebrate cold weather? Obviously, by going to an ice cream festival where you are serenaded by AI-generated music about ice cream including the fantastic lyric “I scream, you scream, we all scream, for ice cream”. I ate a bit too much, so mission successful I think.
